difficultyAxis: Colliding and nesting entity names: Order, OrderItem, OrderItemAdjustment, Return, ReturnLine and Product, where one name prefixes another and two names are Java-keyword-adjacent or SQL-reserved.
rationale: A retail order service whose entity names deliberately nest and collide. A prefix-matching generator that emits one file per name stem, or that truncates at the first match of Order, will lose OrderItemAdjustment or overwrite OrderItem. Return is a Java keyword in lower case and returns is a reserved word in the SQL standard, so identifier derivation cannot be naive. OrderItem also has two foreign keys (orderId, productId), so the pairing between an entity and its references is many-to-one rather than one-to-one.
